_about: The first night (docs/vision/vertical-slice.md beat 8; game-design.md 7.6 on claude-a/game-design-v2): the first prepared raid on Crossroads. core/raids.gd reads it. Positions are world px local to the zone, as in data/plans/crossroads.json; the lane and the gate pad are the plan's own (looked up by id). Every number marked placeholder is one to tune in play-tests; none is balanced. The purse is in data/balance/glint.json (raids.first_night).
title: The first night
why_announce_if: the raid comes from the lantern's light (attention), and is announced only once the homecoming quest is over, so beat 8 follows beat 7 (a decision for Matt)
why_lane_points: the plan's halt_road to the square's edge, then round the north of the well (its box 278-298 x 304-320) to the lantern's west side, clear of its post (307-317 x 290-312): the plan's own last leg runs through the well and ends inside the post (audit of #483, B2). The plan is left as it is; test_raids.gd holds that no point of this lane lies inside a solid

pads.why: inside the street between the bakery (foot at y 288) and the herbalist's (top at y 336): its span closes the street wall to wall, so the halt road is shut until it breaks

the street's mouth onto the square, the same span from wall to wall. Replaces the plan's pad_halt_gate (210, 300), which stands in the open square where a hurdle can be walked round (audit of #483, B1). Where the pads go is Matt's open decision (vertical-slice.md, Open for Matt 6): move them here, in the raid's data

hurdle_barricade.name: Hurdle barricade
hurdle_barricade.text: Blocks the road until it is broken
hurdle_barricade.why_span: world px across the lane when a pad gives no span of its own

lantern.why: a raider strikes the lantern only standing within `reach` world px of its post (`box`, the lit lantern's solid in zones/crossroads/kit.json); `foot` is where its bar hangs from

why_notice: world px: nearer than this, with nothing solid between, a marching creature turns on the player (the camps notice at 100; a raider keeps to its road longer)

waves.why: two boarlets: the hurdles take the first knocks
a toad that spits over the hurdle at the archer
a mossback and the horned elite last

repairs.why: over the smithy's front window (smithy.png, right of the forge mouth); `foot` sorts it in front of the building
south of the gate pad, off the walkway

offers.name: The library's bell tower
offers.why_mark: a restore mark in front of the library's door (248, 200), set out by world/raid_night.gd once the raid is won and the bell tower not yet restored; the plan holds no site for it yet
offers.why: the bell tower (game-design.md 7.2, the library's cupola; act 1's restore id bell_tower at the 50 Glint its mark's lines quote, docs/story/act1.md) is offered for stage 1. core/raids.gd adds it to Village.sites only while no plan defines bell_tower; its restore mark and its picture arrive with stage 1's map and art. Until then the offer is in Hale's lines
